components.name: Stack
components.signature: Stack(children: [Component], direction?: column|row, gap?: sm|md|lg)
components.description: Lays its children out in a column or a row.

components.name: Card
components.signature: Card(children: [Component], title?: text, tone?: tone)
components.description: A bordered block with an optional title: groups parts that belong together (an explorer, a record). Not for a plain paragraph or list.

components.name: Section
components.signature: Section(title: text, children: [Component], open?: true|false, collapsible?: true|false)
components.description: A titled part of the answer, collapsible when it is long.

components.name: Separator
components.signature: Separator()
components.description: A thin rule.

components.name: Heading
components.signature: Heading(text: text, level?: number, tone?: tone)
components.description: A heading inside a block.

components.name: Markdown
components.signature: Markdown(text: text)
components.description: A paragraph of plain text.

components.name: Callout
components.signature: Callout(tone: tone, title: text, body?: text)
components.description: A highlighted note: info, success, warning or danger. For a caveat or a recommendation the reader must not miss; one or two per answer at most.

components.name: Badge
components.signature: Badge(text: text, tone?: tone)
components.description: A short status label.

components.name: Quote
components.signature: Quote(text: text, source?: text)
components.description: A quotation with its source.

components.name: Table
components.signature: Table(columns: [Col|ColGroup], rows: [[cell]|Row], caption?: text, sortable?: true|false, striped?: true|false, compact?: true|false)
components.description: Compare items on criteria, or list records; use it, never a Markdown table. Rows and columns. A cell is a text, a number, a Badge, an Item or a Cell; a row is a list of cells or a Row. Columns may be grouped under a heading with ColGroup.

components.name: Col
components.signature: Col(label: text, kind?: text|number|percent|money|date, align?: left|right|center, tone?: tone)
components.description: A column of Table: its label, how its values are formatted, and a tone that tints the whole column.

components.name: ColGroup
components.signature: ColGroup(label: text, columns: [Col], tone?: tone)
components.description: A heading over several Cols of a Table.

components.name: Row
components.signature: Row(cells: [text|number|Badge|Item|Cell], tone?: tone, kind?: normal|section|total|header)
components.description: A row of a Table that is more than a list of cells: kind section is a title across the whole table, total is a bold closing row, header repeats the column heads.

components.name: Cell
components.signature: Cell(content: text|number|Badge|Item|Cell, tone?: tone, bold?: true|false, colspan?: number, rowspan?: number, align?: left|right|center)
components.description: One cell of a Table with its own colour, weight, alignment or size: colspan merges cells to the right, rowspan merges the cells below (leave them out of the next rows).

components.name: Metric
components.signature: Metric(label: text, value: text|number, delta?: text|number, trend?: up|down|flat, note?: text, tone?: tone)
components.description: One key figure with its label and its change: a result to watch.

components.name: MetricRow
components.signature: MetricRow(metrics: [Metric])
components.description: Several Metric side by side.

components.name: BarChart
components.signature: BarChart(labels: [text], series: [Series], mode?: grouped|stacked, unit?: text, horizontal?: true|false, title?: text, xLabel?: text, yLabel?: text)
components.description: Bars to compare values between categories (sales per quarter); several Series make grouped bars.

components.name: LineChart
components.signature: LineChart(labels: [text], series: [Series], unit?: text, title?: text, xLabel?: text, yLabel?: text)
components.description: Lines to follow a value over ordered labels: a trend over time, a learning curve (loss and accuracy per epoch).

components.name: AreaChart
components.signature: AreaChart(labels: [text], series: [Series], unit?: text, stacked?: true|false, title?: text, xLabel?: text, yLabel?: text)
components.description: Filled lines over ordered labels: a cumulated trend over time.

components.name: PieChart
components.signature: PieChart(labels: [text], values: [number], donut?: true|false, title?: text)
components.description: Shares of a whole with few parts (five at most); with more, a BarChart.

components.name: ScatterChart
components.signature: ScatterChart(series: [Points], xLabel?: text, yLabel?: text, title?: text)
components.description: Points on two axes: the link between two measures, clusters. One colour per Points.

components.name: Series
components.signature: Series(name: text, values: [number], tone?: tone)
components.description: A named list of values, one per label.

components.name: Points
components.signature: Points(name: text, points: [[number]], tone?: tone, line?: true|false)
components.description: A named list of [x, y] points, for ScatterChart or a Plot; line joins them in order (a path, an ROC curve).

components.name: Plot
components.signature: Plot(layers: [Curve|Shade|Dot|VLine|HLine|Points], xmin: number, xmax: number, ymin?: number, ymax?: number, title?: text, xLabel?: text, yLabel?: text)
components.description: The graph of a function of x (a parabola, a derivative, an area), to explore with Sliders; any function is a Plot, never an HTML page. A graph of formulas in x over [xmin, xmax], with the layers drawn on the same axes. The vertical range is automatic unless given.

components.name: Curve
components.signature: Curve(expr: text, label?: text, tone?: tone, dashed?: true|false, op?: value|derivative|integral, show?: text|number)
components.description: A formula in x (x^3 - 3x + 1, sin(2x)/x, e^(-x^2); + - * / ^, sin cos tan exp ln sqrt abs, pi, e). op derivative draws its derivative and integral its antiderivative from xmin, both computed numerically.

components.name: Shade
components.signature: Shade(expr: text, from: text|number, to: text|number, label?: text, tone?: tone, show?: text|number)
components.description: The area between a formula and the x axis from one bound to another; the legend gives its value (the definite integral).

components.name: Dot
components.signature: Dot(x: text|number, y: text|number, label?: text, tone?: tone, show?: text|number)
components.description: A marked point of a Plot (a root, an extremum, an inflection point), with its label. x and y may be formulas in the sliders ("-b/(2*a)") to follow them; so may the bound of a VLine, HLine or Shade.

components.name: VLine
components.signature: VLine(x: text|number, label?: text, tone?: tone, show?: text|number)
components.description: A vertical guide of a Plot at x (an asymptote, a bound).

components.name: HLine
components.signature: HLine(y: text|number, label?: text, tone?: tone, show?: text|number)
components.description: A horizontal guide of a Plot at y (an asymptote, a threshold, a mean).

components.name: Slider
components.signature: Slider(name: text, min: number, max: number, value?: number, step?: number, label?: text)
components.description: A slider the reader moves to change a variable (name: a, b, h, amp; not x, e, pi) that the formulas of Curve, Shade and Live use.

components.name: Toggle
components.signature: Toggle(name: text, label?: text, value?: true|false)
components.description: A switch: a variable, 1 when on and 0 when off (value true starts it on).

components.name: Select
components.signature: Select(name: text, options: [text], value?: number, label?: text)
components.description: A list of choices: the variable is the number of the choice made, from 0.

components.name: Live
components.signature: Live(text: text)
components.description: Markdown text where {{formula}} shows its value with the current sliders: "$f(x) = {{a}}x^2$", "vertex ({{h}}, {{k}})", "{{2*a+b}}". Write * between a number and a variable. Formulas give numbers: no text, no a > b ? x : y.

components.name: Histogram
components.signature: Histogram(values: [number], bins?: number, title?: text, xLabel?: text, tone?: tone)
components.description: The distribution of a list of values, in equal bins: the spread of a measure (a residual, a feature, a weight).

components.name: Heatmap
components.signature: Heatmap(rows: [text], cols: [text], values: [[number]], title?: text, tone?: tone, decimals?: number)
components.description: A grid of numbers shaded by value: a confusion matrix, a correlation matrix, an attention map.

components.name: Architecture
components.signature: Architecture(children: [Component], flows?: [Flow], title?: text, direction?: column|row, framed?: true|false)
components.description: A system, its layers or a data flow, up to about fifteen boxes. The frame of a system drawing: it lays Panels out and draws the Flow arrows over them. direction row puts them side by side, as the stages of a pipeline; framed draws a frame around all, with the title large.

components.name: Panel
components.signature: Panel(children: [Component], title?: text, tone?: tone, icon?: icon, dashed?: true|false, direction?: column|row)
components.description: A coloured box with a title and an icon that holds Items or other Panels, in a column or in a wrapping row. Give it its own name to link it with a Flow.

components.name: Item
components.signature: Item(label: text, icon?: icon, caption?: text, boxed?: true|false, tone?: tone, shape?: box|cylinder|hexagon|pill)
components.description: A line with an icon, a label and a caption; boxed draws it as a card, shape cylinder as a database, hexagon or pill for a step. Give it its own name to link it with a Flow.

components.name: Flow
components.signature: Flow(from: name, to: name, label?: text, both?: true|false, style?: solid|dashed|block)
components.description: An arrow between two Panels or Items, by the names of their statements. Only inside the flows of an Architecture.

components.name: Steps
components.signature: Steps(items: [Step])
components.description: An ordered procedure of three steps or more: a how-to, a setup.

components.name: Step
components.signature: Step(title: text, body?: text, status?: todo|doing|done|blocked)
components.description: One step of Steps.

components.name: FileRef
components.signature: FileRef(path: text, label?: text, page?: number, line?: number)
components.description: A file or a place in a file; a click opens it in the app.

components.name: Citation
components.signature: Citation(label: text, source: text, quote?: text, page?: number)
components.description: A passage taken from a source, with its place.

components.name: SourceList
components.signature: SourceList(sources: [Source])
components.description: The sources an answer relies on.

components.name: Source
components.signature: Source(title: text, url?: text, path?: text, note?: text, site?: text)
components.description: One source of SourceList.

components.name: SourcePills
components.signature: SourcePills(sources: [Source])
components.description: Pills for the sites a web search drew from.

components.name: Link
components.signature: Link(label: text, url: text)
components.description: A link to a web page.

components.name: Button
components.signature: Button(label: text, action: @Ask("text")|@OpenFile(path)|@OpenUrl(url), variant?: primary|secondary)
components.description: A button that runs an action.

components.name: Choices
components.signature: Choices(options: [Choice], title?: text)
components.description: Suggested follow-ups under the answer. At most one per answer.

components.name: Choice
components.signature: Choice(label: text, action: @Ask("text")|@OpenFile(path)|@OpenUrl(url), description?: text, icon?: icon)
components.description: One follow-up of Choices; a description makes it a card.

components.name: Form
components.signature: Form(children: [Component], submit: Submit, title?: text)
components.description: Lets the reader answer inside the answer: fields, a Counter, then one Submit that sends their text back to you as their next message. For an exercise, a quiz, a text to correct. One per answer; never ask for a secret.

components.name: TextArea
components.signature: TextArea(name: text, placeholder?: text, rows?: number, value?: text)
components.description: A box for a longer text, inside a Form. name is how a template refers to it; value is the text it starts with.

components.name: Field
components.signature: Field(name: text, label?: text, placeholder?: text, value?: text, kind?: text)
components.description: A line to fill in. kind "number": a variable that graphs and Live read by name.

components.name: Counter
components.signature: Counter(of: text, unit?: text, min?: number, max?: number)
components.description: Counts the words of a field (of is its name); min and max colour it. unit is the word for the count, in the language of the reader.

components.name: Submit
components.signature: Submit(label: text, template: text, requires?: [text])
components.description: The button of a Form. template is the message you will receive, written as the reader would, with {{name}} where the text of a field goes. Disabled until the fields in requires (all by default) are filled.

components.name: Quiz
components.signature: Quiz(questions: [Question], title?: text, report?: text)
components.description: To test knowledge. Multiple-choice questions answered in the answer, judged at once with their explanation, then a score. Optional report: the message the reader may send at the end, with {{score}}, {{total}}, {{missed}}. The answers are visible: a study tool, not an exam.

components.name: Question
components.signature: Question(text: text, options: [text], answer: number, explanation?: text)
components.description: A question of a Quiz: 2 to 6 options; answer is the number of the right one, counting from 0.

components.name: Flashcards
components.signature: Flashcards(cards: [Flash], title?: text, report?: text)
components.description: To memorise: vocabulary, definitions. Cards the reader flips and marks known or to review. Optional report, with {{known}}, {{total}}, {{again}} (fronts to review).

components.name: Flash
components.signature: Flash(front: text, back: text, tag?: text, note?: text)
components.description: A card: front (a word), back (the answer), tag on the front (a category), note under the back (a pronunciation, an example).

components.name: Browser
components.signature: Browser(children: [Component], url?: text, bg?: text, font?: sans|serif|mono|display, radius?: none|sm|md|lg|full)
components.description: A quick sketch to talk over, not the site; to build it, write the files. A browser window to sketch a page in. bg is the page colour; a colour is a hex code (#f97316), a name (orange), rgb(249, 115, 22) or hsl(25, 95%, 53%), and a gradient is "#f97316 > #ec4899". font: sans, serif, mono, display. radius of the corners: none, sm, md, lg, full.

components.name: Phone
components.signature: Phone(children: [Component], bg?: text, font?: sans|serif|mono|display, radius?: none|sm|md|lg|full)
components.description: A phone screen to sketch an app in, like Browser (bg, font, radius).

components.name: Nav
components.signature: Nav(brand: text, links?: [text], cta?: text, color?: text)
components.description: The navigation bar of a page: brand, links, a call to action in color.

components.name: Hero
components.signature: Hero(title: text, subtitle?: text, primary?: text, secondary?: text, color?: text, align?: center|left)
components.description: The top of a page: a title on a gradient of color, a subtitle, two buttons. Texts take a readable colour by themselves.

components.name: Features
components.signature: Features(items: [Feature], columns?: number)
components.description: A grid of Feature cards (columns 1 to 4).

components.name: Feature
components.signature: Feature(title: text, text?: text, icon?: icon, color?: text)
components.description: A card of Features: title, text, an icon, a color.

components.name: Grid
components.signature: Grid(children: [Component], columns?: number)
components.description: Its children in 1 to 4 equal columns.

components.name: Picture
components.signature: Picture(label?: text, color?: text, ratio?: number)
components.description: A picture placeholder: a gradient of color with a label; ratio is width over height.

components.name: Cta
components.signature: Cta(label: text, color?: text, variant?: solid|outline)
components.description: A button of a page, solid or outline.

components.name: Plans
components.signature: Plans(items: [Plan])
components.description: Pricing: up to 4 Plan cards side by side.

components.name: Plan
components.signature: Plan(name: text, price: text, features?: [text], cta?: text, color?: text, highlight?: true|false)
components.description: A price card: name, price, up to 8 features, a button; highlight marks the one to choose.

components.name: Stats
components.signature: Stats(items: [Stat])
components.description: A row of up to 6 big figures.

components.name: Stat
components.signature: Stat(value: text, label: text)
components.description: A figure of Stats: its value (10k+) and its label.

components.name: Testimonial
components.signature: Testimonial(quote: text, author: text, role?: text, color?: text)
components.description: A quote with its author, their role, and their initials in a coloured circle.

components.name: Avatar
components.signature: Avatar(name: text, color?: text)
components.description: A coloured circle with the initials of a name.

components.name: Logos
components.signature: Logos(names: [text], title?: text)
components.description: A row of up to 8 names with their logo when it is a known technology (react, postgres).

components.name: Shell
components.signature: Shell(items: [SideItem], children: [Component], title?: text, color?: text)
components.description: A quick sketch of a dashboard to talk over. A dashboard layout: a side bar of SideItem (the first is the current page) and a main area of Tiles, Kpis, Sparks, DataRows. title is the product name.

components.name: SideItem
components.signature: SideItem(label: text, icon?: icon, active?: true|false)
components.description: An entry of the side bar of a Shell: a label, an icon, active.

components.name: Tile
components.signature: Tile(children: [Component], title?: text)
components.description: A bordered box of a dashboard, with a title.

components.name: Kpi
components.signature: Kpi(label: text, value: text, delta?: text, color?: text)
components.description: A figure of a dashboard: label, value, change (+12% is green, -3% red).

components.name: Spark
components.signature: Spark(values: [number], color?: text, kind?: line|bars)
components.description: A small curve or bars from up to 60 numbers.

components.name: DataRows
components.signature: DataRows(columns: [text], rows: [[text]])
components.description: A table of a page: up to 6 columns, 12 rows of text.

components.name: Palette
components.signature: Palette(swatches: [Swatch], title?: text)
components.description: The colours of a design or a brand, each with its name and its code: to propose a palette.

components.name: Swatch
components.signature: Swatch(color: text, name?: text)
components.description: A colour of a Palette: a colour or a gradient, and its name.

components.name: Footer
components.signature: Footer(text: text, links?: [text])
components.description: The foot of a page: a line of text and a few links.

components.name: Hive
components.signature: Hive(columns: [[Hex]], title?: text, left?: text, right?: text)
components.description: Parts that touch. A honeycomb of hexagons, in columns of one, two, one, two...: a strategy or a model whose parts touch. left and right are the headings of the two groups. Colour the one to stress.

components.name: Hex
components.signature: Hex(label: text, color?: text)
components.description: A hexagon of a Hive: a short label and a color.

components.name: Chevrons
components.signature: Chevrons(items: [Chev], title?: text)
components.description: A process in arrow-shaped steps, each with a short text: a method, phases of a roadmap.

components.name: Chev
components.signature: Chev(label: text, text?: text, color?: text)
components.description: A step of Chevrons.

components.name: Cycle
components.signature: Cycle(loops: [Loop], center?: text, title?: text)
components.description: Three to eight steps in a loop, with arrows from one to the next (a lifecycle, PDCA, a flywheel); center is the word in the middle.

components.name: Loop
components.signature: Loop(label: text, color?: text)
components.description: A step of a Cycle.

components.name: Pyramid
components.signature: Pyramid(levels: [Level], title?: text, funnel?: true|false)
components.description: Levels from the top down, widening: a hierarchy or a scale (Maslow). funnel true makes it narrow downwards: a funnel of conversion.

components.name: Level
components.signature: Level(label: text, text?: text, color?: text)
components.description: A level of a Pyramid.

components.name: Hub
components.signature: Hub(core: Spoke, spokes: [Spoke], title?: text, arrows?: text)
components.description: A centre (core, a Spoke) and two to eight Spokes around it, joined to it by arrows: what presses on a subject (the five forces of Porter, with four Spokes around the rivalry), stakeholders, an ecosystem, a mind map. arrows: in (towards the centre, the default), out or none.

components.name: Spoke
components.signature: Spoke(label: text, text?: text, color?: text)
components.description: The centre or a satellite of a Hub: a label, a short text, a color.

components.name: Quadrant
components.signature: Quadrant(cells: [Quad], xLabel?: text, yLabel?: text, title?: text)
components.description: A matrix of two by two (urgent/important, effort/impact), four Quad in order: top left, top right, bottom left, bottom right. xLabel and yLabel name the axes.

components.name: Quad
components.signature: Quad(title: text, text?: text, color?: text)
components.description: A cell of a Quadrant: a title, a text, a color (a hex code or a name such as red, never a tone).

components.name: Layers
components.signature: Layers(layers: [Layer], title?: text)
components.description: A stack of levels, the top one first: a label on the left and its text on the right (network layers, a stack seen as levels).

components.name: Layer
components.signature: Layer(label: text, text?: text, color?: text)
components.description: A layer of Layers.

components.name: Venn
components.signature: Venn(sets: [VSet], center?: text, title?: text)
components.description: Two or three sets that overlap, each a VSet; center names what they share.

components.name: VSet
components.signature: VSet(label: text, text?: text, color?: text)
components.description: A set of a Venn: its label, a short text, a color.

components.name: Tree
components.signature: Tree(root: Branch, title?: text)
components.description: A decision tree, an org chart or a breakdown from one root Branch, its children below, up to four levels.

components.name: Branch
components.signature: Branch(label: text, children?: [Branch], text?: text, color?: text)
components.description: A node of a Tree: a label, its children (Branch), a short text, a color.

components.name: Sheet
components.signature: Sheet(columns: [text], rows?: [[text]], title?: text, report?: text)
components.description: A table the reader fills in and sends back (a budget, a list). report: the message they may send, with {{table}}, {{rows}}. For a spreadsheet to open elsewhere, write a file.

components.name: Draft
components.signature: Draft(body: text, subject?: text, to?: text, title?: text)
components.description: For a mail or a letter they will send. A text the reader can edit and copy: an email, a letter. subject and to are optional lines above the body.

components.name: ProgressBar
components.signature: ProgressBar(value: number, max?: number, label?: text, tone?: tone)
components.description: A bar filled to value out of max (100 by default): a score, a level, a completion.

components.name: SegmentBar
components.signature: SegmentBar(segments: [Segment], unit?: text, title?: text)
components.description: A bar cut in parts in proportion to their value: how a session or a budget is shared. unit follows each figure (min, h, EUR).

components.name: Segment
components.signature: Segment(label: text, value: number, tone?: tone)
components.description: One part of SegmentBar: its label (what it is) and its value (the figure, in the unit of the bar).

examples:
root = Stack([title, kpis, table, note])
title = Heading("Terminal agents compared", 2)
kpis = MetricRow([m1, m2])
m1 = Metric("Tools compared", 5)
m2 = Metric("With a native sandbox", 3, "+1", "up")
table = Table([Col("Tool"), Col("Sandbox"), Col("Memory")], rows)
rows = [["Claude Code", Badge("yes", "success"), "CLAUDE.md"], ["Aider", Badge("no", "danger"), "chat history"]]
note = Callout("warning", "Not documented", "OpenCode does not document its internal database schema.")

root = Steps([s1, s2, s3])
s1 = Step("Install the runtime", "Run the installer, then restart the terminal.", "done")
s2 = Step("Add a provider key", "Open Settings, then Providers.", "doing")
s3 = Step("Send a first message")

root = Card([summary, plan], "Migration status", "info")
summary = MetricRow([Metric("Tables moved", 14, "+3", "up", "this week"), Metric("Left", 6)])
plan = Section("Next", [Steps([Step("Move the audit tables", null, "doing"), Step("Switch the reads", null, "todo")])])

root = Architecture([clients, runtime, storage], [f1, f2, f3], "Local app")
clients = Panel([ui, docs], "Inputs", "violet", "monitor", false, "row")
ui = Item("Desktop UI", "monitor", "React", true)
docs = Item("Documents", "files", "PDF, DOCX", true)
runtime = Panel([api, jobs, agents], "Runtime", "orange", "si:go", false, "row")
api = Item("HTTP API", "api", "Commands, streaming", true)
jobs = Item("Jobs", "workflow", "Indexing", true)
agents = Item("Agents", "ai", "LLM, tools", true)
storage = Panel([sql, olap], "Storage", "blue", "database", true, "row")
sql = Item("SQLite", "si:sqlite", "Transactions", true)
olap = Item("DuckDB", "si:duckdb", "Analytics", true)
f1 = Flow("ui", "api", null, true)
f2 = Flow("docs", "jobs", "ingest")
f3 = Flow("api", "sql")

root = Table([Col("Tool"), install, writes], rows, "Three engines compared", false, true)
install = ColGroup("Install", [Col("Size (MB)", "number"), Col("Setup")])
writes = ColGroup("Writes", [Col("Concurrent"), Col("Mode")], "violet")
rows = [Row(["Embedded"], "blue", "section"), ["SQLite", 1, "None", Cell("one writer", "warning"), "WAL"], ["DuckDB", 30, "None", Cell("one writer", "warning"), "Columnar"], Row(["Server"], "blue", "section"), ["PostgreSQL", 300, "Installer", Cell("many writers", "success", true), "MVCC"], Row(["Smallest", "SQLite"], null, "total")]

root = Stack([intro, plot, curve])
intro = Heading("f(x) = x^3 - 3x + 1 and its derivative", 3)
plot = Plot([f, slope, extremum1, extremum2, axis], -3, 3, null, null, "f and f'", "x", "y")
f = Curve("x^3 - 3x + 1", "f(x)", "blue")
slope = Curve("3x^2 - 3", "f'(x)", "orange", true)
extremum1 = Dot(-1, 3, "local maximum (-1, 3)", "red")
extremum2 = Dot(1, -1, "local minimum (1, -1)", "red")
axis = HLine(0)
curve = Plot([Curve("x^3 - 3x + 1", "f(x)"), Shade("x^3 - 3x + 1", -2, 2, "area under f")], -3, 3, null, null, "Integral from -2 to 2")

root = Stack([loss, matrix, errors])
loss = LineChart(["1", "2", "3", "4", "5"], [Series("train", [0.92, 0.55, 0.38, 0.29, 0.24]), Series("validation", [0.95, 0.63, 0.47, 0.42, 0.41])], null, "Loss per epoch", "epoch", "loss")
matrix = Heatmap(["cat", "dog", "bird"], ["cat", "dog", "bird"], [[48, 2, 0], [5, 41, 4], [1, 3, 46]], "Confusion matrix", "blue", 0)
